verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm that https://amplitude.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an Amplitude summary, and that a Markdown docs index at /docs.md is live. A machine-readable openapi.json is also served, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or advertising these agent-oriented docs, and verification of how complete the llms.txt/docs.md content is beyond the index headers.
